content: Mɨyatiuyɨkukeri ti'aitame 'Atsuheru 'Amani waɨkawa mariweme kanayeitɨani Hamerata nu'aya, 'Akaki nuiwarieya, kanipitɨani hetsɨana mɨti'uximayakakɨ matsi waɨkawa katinipitɨani keyuri hipame.

Yunaitɨ te'uximayatamete paratsiyu kitenie miemete ti'aitame muwayekatsie, mekaniukatunuma'uwekaitɨni 'Amani hɨxie, mariweme mekanayeitɨwakaitɨni, ti'aitame mɨpaɨ mɨtiu'aitakaikɨ. Peru Maxirukeyu hɨxiena pɨka'ukatunumakiekakai meta mariweme pɨka'eriekai.
Hikɨ paratsiyuta memɨte'uximaya ti'aitame kitenie memɨhɨritɨariekai, Maxirukeyu mɨpaɨ mekateniuta'iwawiya: «¿Titayari ti'aitame kemaine yapekatikamie?»

Tukari meukayunetsie mekanitate'akaitɨni mɨixa. Peru mɨkɨ pɨkawa'eniekai. 'Ayumieme mekanitaxata 'Amani hetsɨa mixeiyakɨ Maxirukeyu kemɨyɨanekai, mɨkɨri kaniyutaxatakaitɨni kename huriyu tewiyaritɨkai.
Kepauka 'Amani Maxirukeyu muxei hɨxiena mɨka'ukatunumakiekakaikɨ meta mariweme mɨka'eriekaikɨ kaniuyeha'ani.

Kepauka 'Amani mɨretima Maxirukeyu hakewa mekiekametɨkai, katiniuhayewa yuxaɨtame 'imienike kanitiwauni yunaime Maxirukeyu teɨterimama wahetsɨa, tatsuari huriyutsixi 'Atsuheru mɨra'aitakaitsie memɨtamakai.

Hikɨ mexɨakame metseriyaritsie nitsahani tamamata heimana huta wiyari 'Atsuheru ti'aitakaku, mekaniuyuta'iwa 'Amani hɨxie, yamemɨtehetimanikɨ kemɨ'ane metseritsie meta tukaritsie mɨtinake, huriyutisixi memɨkwi'iwakɨ. Hikɨ 'inɨari memuwewi katinikanake tamamata heimana huta, 'araxi metseriyaritsie.

Hikɨ 'Amani ti'aitame 'Atsuheru mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —'Ena mepuxuawe hipatɨ teɨteri naitsarie metaxɨrietɨ kiekari mukumanetsie watsata pemɨra'aitatsie, 'inɨari niukiyari kememɨtehexeiya kememɨte'uhu yɨkɨ pɨ'ane, hipatɨ kememɨteheixeiya. Yamepɨkatekahu 'inɨari niukiyaritsie kepemɨti'aita, 'aixɨa pɨka'ane memu'uwani me'ayenenieretɨ.

Xɨka matsinakeni xapa keneutawewi raka'ukame memɨkwi'iwakɨ, ne nekaniyetuamɨkɨ te'uximayatamete wahɨxie haika tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari heimana tamamata miriyari (330.000) kiruyari pɨrata, tumini mɨwati'utsiwa mɨyuhayewakɨ.
Hikɨ ti'aitame hanira tseyuyari yumamatsie 'anutihɨnaka 'Amani kaniu'ɨitɨani Hamerata nu'aya, 'Akaki nuiwarieya meta huriyutsixi mɨwaraye'unie.
Ti'aitame 'Amani mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —'Atumini kena'ɨtɨ kemɨmatinake yakeniwareyuri mɨkɨ teɨteri.

Mexɨakame metseritsie tamamata heimana hairieka tukaritsie mekaniuta'inierieni te'utɨwamete ti'aitame hetsɨa memɨte'uximaya. Mekatenaka'utɨani kiekari mukumane wa'utɨarikakɨ meta waniukikɨ kemɨtiwa'aitɨakai, 'Amani ti'aitame mɨtiwa'aitɨakai kwie mukumanetsie te'uximayatamete yɨkɨ memɨte'uniuka muwa memɨte'uximayakai kuwexinaruritsixi meta wa'ukiyarima. Naitɨ katinaka'utsieni kename ti'aitame 'Atsuheru haine, meta kanititseyumani ti'aitame hanirayakɨ.

Hikɨ xapa me'utiwewieka tupiritsixi mekaniwareutanɨ'axɨani, kwie mukumanetsie mɨpaɨ mekateniwarunɨ'ani memɨwakwinikɨ yunaime huriyutsixi temari, 'ukirawetsixi, 'ukarawetsixi, tɨɨri meta wapiini memɨtewanawairienikɨ xeitukaritsie, tamamata hairieka tukaritsie tamamata heimana hutarieka metseritsie, tatsɨari 'araxi metseriyaritsie.
Kwie mukumanetɨkatsie 'inɨari niukiyari 'ɨkiyari mepexeiyatɨkani, mɨpaɨ memɨteyukuxaxatɨwanikɨ memɨyukuha'aritɨwanikɨ mɨkɨ tukaritsie.

Hikɨ tupiritsixi mekaneutayeixɨani ti'aitame yatiwaruta'aitɨaku, meta tsiere mɨkɨ xapa kaniutaxatsieni Tsutsa kiekariyaritsie. Hikɨ ti'aitame 'Amani hamatɨa me'anukayaxeka mekananu'ieni, mexi Tsutsa kiekariyaritsie mekayumaiwawekai.
